localizedText.FIRST_MESSAGE: First message. Sent upon initialization of this sample extension.
localizedText.ANOTHER_MESSAGE: Another message. Sent because the 'SendAnotherMessage' function symbol was called.
localizedText.ALARM_RAISED_DURING_EXTENSION_INITIALIZA: An alarm raised during extension initialization. If not already confirmed, it can be confirmed by calling the 'ConfirmAlarm' function symbol.
